Context: 12. Relaxation of consultation norms in respect of CGHS beneficiaries aged 75 years and above

- (ii-a) It is clarified that there is no provision to undergo investigations at CGHS empanelled diagnostic laboratories and imaging centres without advice from Government specialists / CGHS Medical Officer I Specialists of empanelled hospitals. In case of unlisted investigations, approval of Competent Authority is necessary before undergoing such investigations. OM, dated 1-10-2021.
